title: Journalist & Whistleblower Privacy Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your privacy risk as a journalist or whistleblower. Get personalized security recommendations to protect sources and communications.
description: Assess your privacy risks and vulnerabilities as a journalist or whistleblower. This calculator evaluates your current security practices and provides actionable recommendations to protect sensitive sources and communications.

inputs.helpText: Rate your device security practices (1=basic, 5=advanced encryption/hardening)

inputs.helpText: Assess the legal and political environment where you work

inputs.helpText: What types of stories do you typically investigate?

inputs.helpText: Rate your current source protection practices (1=minimal, 5=comprehensive anonymization)

formula: const commRisk = { 'email': 80, 'encrypted-email': 40, 'messaging': 70, 'secure-messaging': 20, 'anonymous': 10 }[communicationMethods]; const locRisk = { 'low': 20, 'moderate': 50, 'high': 90 }[locationRisk]; const storyRisk = { 'low': 20, 'medium': 50, 'high': 80 }[storyType]; const toolsRisk = { 'none': 90, 'basic': 60, 'intermediate': 30, 'advanced': 10 }[internetUsage]; const deviceFactor = (6 - deviceSecurity) * 15; const sourceFactor = (6 - sourceProtection) * 12; const rawRisk = (commRisk + locRisk + storyRisk + toolsRisk + deviceFactor + sourceFactor) / 6; const overallRisk = Math.min(95, Math.max(5, rawRisk)); const securityScore = Math.round(100 - overallRisk); const riskCategory = overallRisk >= 70 ? 'Critical Risk': overallRisk >= 50 ? 'High Risk': overallRisk >= 30 ? 'Moderate Risk': 'Low Risk'; return { overallRisk: Math.round(overallRisk), securityScore, riskCategory };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates privacy risks for journalists and whistleblowers by analyzing communication methods, operational security practices, threat environment, and story sensitivity. The assessment considers real-world factors that affect source protection and personal safety in journalism.
tips: Use Signal or Wire for source communications instead of regular messaging apps
Consider using a privacy-focused browser or Tor for sensitive research and source contact
Implement full-disk encryption on all devices that could be seized
Establish secure communication protocols before contacting sensitive sources
Regularly update your threat model based on current stories and political climate

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Good security practices in place. Continue monitoring and stay updated on emerging threats.

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk
interpretation.description: Some vulnerabilities present. Upgrade communication tools and source protection methods.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant security gaps. Immediate improvements needed in multiple areas.

interpretation.label: Critical Risk
interpretation.description: Serious privacy vulnerabilities. Comprehensive security overhaul required immediately.
